propositions: Close must verify current plan-review attestation and material validity at the moment of close, without re-running review or invalidating on implementation file changes.

CLOSE validity profile must accept certified, registry-current, material-current, phase-compatible reviews while rejecting unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, and phase incompatibility regardless of pin-enforcement setting.
Pin drift, missing, or malformed validity verdicts must block only when enforce_plan_material_pins is true; all other validity failures must block unconditionally.

A generic pre_status_check callback must execute inside the existing transaction lock immediately before STATUS append, enabling close to recheck plan validity after acquiring the critical section but before committing.
Close gate enforcement must be opt-in via require_plan_review_for_close config flag defaulting false, preserving byte-for-byte existing behavior when disabled.
Unexpected exceptions, signature/parse failures, or missing attestation must fail closed as unavailable verdict without traceback or network/model calls.
